name: measurement_step_derivative_kick
description: Setpoint stays at 0; measurement steps from 0 to -2 at t=0.2 (a sensor reading suddenly dropping). PID.c computes the derivative term from the CHANGE in measurement between steps, so this one step should produce a brief, large spike in differentiator_state that decays toward 0 over roughly tau=0.02s, while a setpoint step (see 05) produces none. No checks: this is meant to be watched on the result graph, not just pass/fail.
